releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.36
releases.summary: Smoother playback return, clearer episode information and personalized rows.

sections.heading: Playback and navigation
bullets: Watched progress refreshes without the Sync Options chooser. Options retain focus while previews are pending. Kodi settings appear first, with tracking settings available manually.

sections.heading: Make each section yours
bullets: Move, pin, hide and restore rows independently in each section. Known series status and episode air dates use existing metadata without additional online lookups.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn. Your saved accounts, playback settings, sources, watched progress, row arrangements and unrelated add-ons remain in place. Both branded icon packs remain included.

sections.heading: Ratings in Appearance
bullets: Find Rating sources and Rating order together under Appearance. Your existing rating choices stay saved.

sections.heading: Relevant tracking controls

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.38
releases.summary: Your own collections, saved searches, movie-series order and something new when you’re caught up.

sections.heading: Make it your own
bullets: Create and arrange personal collections in My Stuff. Save named searches with their search category and reopen current results.

sections.heading: Keep your place
bullets: View a movie series in release order with its next released unwatched title. Local shelves keep watched and resume status current.

sections.heading: Find your next series
bullets: When the last available episode finishes, optional suggestions let you inspect, save or open another show. Another series never starts automatically. Returning shows are supported when you’re caught up.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Local shelves prepare metadata with fewer copies. Watched and resume status remain current.

Update BlackLanturn keeps accounts, playback settings, sources, progress, collections, saved searches, row arrangements and unrelated add-ons. Current compatibility patches and both icon packs remain included.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.39
releases.summary: Clearer next-series actions, simpler browsing options and more reliable episode-end handling.

sections.heading: Know which show you are choosing
bullets: The selected recommendation stays outlined and its title remains visible while using Browse show, Read synopsis or Save to My Stuff.

sections.heading: Keep browsing options focused
bullets: Customize rows is now in Settings → Skin & discovery → Rows. Existing arrangements and custom rows stay saved. Trakt recommendation rows keep their current source.

sections.heading: More reliable episode endings
bullets: Play Next keeps its end-of-file fallback when the online credits marker cannot be reached. Episode-end rating controls accept native integer episode identifiers.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Update BlackLanturn preserves authorizations, playback settings, sources, saved titles, collections, searches, progress and unrelated add-ons. Both icon packs and existing compatibility fixes remain included.
